note.en: Hinton praised Fei-Fei Li's new book, crediting her as the first computer vision researcher to grasp the power of big data.
note.zh: Hinton称赞Fei-Fei Li的新书，认为她是最早领悟大数据威力的计算机视觉研究者。

title.en: I suspect that Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun have missed the main reason why the big companies want regulations. Years ago the founder of a self-driving company told
title.zh: I suspect that Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun have missed the main reason why the big companies want regulations. Years ago the founder of a self-driving company told

note.en: Hinton argued Andrew Ng and Yann LeCun missed why big AI companies actually favor regulation, citing a self-driving founder's account of safety rules as a competitive moat.
note.zh: Hinton认为Andrew Ng和Yann LeCun误解了大型AI公司支持监管的真正原因，援引一位自动驾驶公司创始人的说法，指监管规则实为竞争壁垒。

title.en: Andrew Ng is claiming that the idea that AI could make us extinct is a big-tech conspiracy. A datapoint that does not fit this conspiracy theory is that I left
title.zh: Andrew Ng is claiming that the idea that AI could make us extinct is a big-tech conspiracy. A datapoint that does not fit this conspiracy theory is that I left

note.en: Hinton rebutted Andrew Ng's claim that AI-extinction risk is a big-tech conspiracy, pointing out he himself left Google to speak freely about it.
note.zh: Hinton反驳Andrew Ng所说AI灭绝风险是大科技公司阴谋的说法，指出自己正是为了能自由谈论这一风险才离开谷歌。

title.en: New paper: https://t.co/NJyQRsLZ71 Companies are planning to train models with 100x more computation than today’s state of the art, within 18 months. No one kno
title.zh: New paper: https://t.co/NJyQRsLZ71 Companies are planning to train models with 100x more computation than today’s state of the art, within 18 months. No one kno

note.en: Hinton shared a new paper warning that companies plan to train models with 100x more compute within 18 months, with unknown resulting capabilities.
note.zh: Hinton分享了一篇新论文，警告各公司计划在18个月内训练算力提升百倍的模型，其能力后果尚属未知。

title.en: Since leaving Google, I have received many requests to join the advisory boards of start-ups and, until now, I have declined them all. However, I have decided t
title.zh: Since leaving Google, I have received many requests to join the advisory boards of start-ups and, until now, I have declined them all. However, I have decided t

note.en: Hinton said he broke his pattern of declining startup advisory requests to join Vayu Robotics as an advisor.
note.zh: Hinton表示他打破了一贯拒绝初创公司顾问邀请的做法，加入Vayu Robotics担任顾问。

title.en: A Generalist Framework for Panoptic Segmentation of Images and Videos
title.zh: A Generalist Framework for Panoptic Segmentation of Images and Videos

note.en: ICCV 2023 paper co-authored by Hinton that formulates panoptic segmentation of images and video as a diffusion-based discrete generation problem.
note.zh: Hinton合著的ICCV 2023论文，将图像与视频的全景分割问题构建为基于扩散模型的离散生成问题。

title.en: The University of Toronto made a video for a non technical audience in which I explain how deep learning works, the enormous promise of this technology and some
title.zh: The University of Toronto made a video for a non technical audience in which I explain how deep learning works, the enormous promise of this technology and some

note.en: The University of Toronto released a video in which Hinton explains deep learning, its promise, and its risks for a general audience.
note.zh: 多伦多大学发布了一段视频，Hinton在其中向大众讲解深度学习的原理及其前景与风险。

title.en: Robust and data-efficient generalization of self-supervised machine learning for diagnostic imaging
title.zh: Robust and data-efficient generalization of self-supervised machine learning for diagnostic imaging

note.en: Nature Biomedical Engineering paper co-authored by Hinton presenting REMEDIS, a self-supervised pretraining strategy that makes medical-imaging AI more robust and data-efficient.
note.zh: Hinton合著的Nature Biomedical Engineering论文，提出自监督预训练策略REMEDIS，提升医学影像AI模型的鲁棒性与数据效率。

title.en: Dishonest CBC headline: "Canada's AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton says AI could wipe out humans. In the meantime, there's money to be made". The second sentence was
title.zh: Dishonest CBC headline: "Canada's AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton says AI could wipe out humans. In the meantime, there's money to be made". The second sentence was

note.en: Hinton corrected a CBC headline that spliced his AI-extinction warning together with an unrelated line from the journalist about money to be made, calling it dishonest.
note.zh: Hinton纠正CBC一则标题，称其将他关于AI灭绝风险的警告与记者自己那句“仍有钱可赚”的话拼接在一起，做法不诚实。

title.en: In the NYT today, Cade Metz implies that I left Google so that I could criticize Google. Actually, I left so that I could talk about the dangers of AI without c
title.zh: In the NYT today, Cade Metz implies that I left Google so that I could criticize Google. Actually, I left so that I could talk about the dangers of AI without c

note.en: Hinton rebutted a NYT report by Cade Metz implying he left Google to criticize it, saying he left so his warnings about AI risk wouldn't be weighed against Google's business interests.
note.zh: Hinton反驳《纽约时报》记者Cade Metz的报道，称报道暗示他离开谷歌是为了批评公司，实际上他是为了让自己对AI风险的警告不必顾及谷歌的商业利益。

title.en: Reinforcement Learning by Human Feedback is just parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.
title.zh: Reinforcement Learning by Human Feedback is just parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.

note.en: Hinton described reinforcement learning from human feedback as 'parenting for a supernaturally precocious child.'
note.zh: Hinton将基于人类反馈的强化学习比作“抚养一个超自然早熟的孩子”。

title.en: Caterpillars extract nutrients which are then converted into butterflies. People have extracted billions of nuggets of understanding and GPT-4 is humanity's but
title.zh: Caterpillars extract nutrients which are then converted into butterflies. People have extracted billions of nuggets of understanding and GPT-4 is humanity's but

note.en: Hinton compared GPT-4 to a butterfly distilled from humanity's collective understanding, likening people to nutrient-extracting caterpillars.
note.zh: Hinton将GPT-4比作从人类集体知识中提炼而成的“蝴蝶”，把人比作汲取养分的“毛毛虫”。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton: Unpacking The Forward-Forward Algorithm
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton: Unpacking The Forward-Forward Algorithm

note.en: Hinton explains his Forward-Forward learning algorithm, an alternative to backpropagation, in a long-form interview.
note.zh: 欣顿在一次长篇访谈中讲解了他提出的前向-前向（Forward-Forward）学习算法，这是反向传播的一种替代方案。

title.en: The Forward-Forward Algorithm: Some Preliminary Investigations
title.zh: The Forward-Forward Algorithm: Some Preliminary Investigations

note.en: His sole-authored proposal of the Forward-Forward algorithm, which replaces backpropagation's backward pass with a second forward pass on negative data.
note.zh: 他独立署名提出 Forward-Forward 算法，用一次针对负样本的正向传播取代反向传播的回传过程。

title.en: How to Represent Part-Whole Hierarchies in a Neural Network
title.zh: How to Represent Part-Whole Hierarchies in a Neural Network

note.en: Hinton's own paper proposing GLOM, an architecture for representing part-whole hierarchies of objects in a neural network using islands of agreement among vectors.
note.zh: Hinton本人的论文，提出GLOM架构，通过向量间的"共识孤岛"在神经网络中表示物体的部分-整体层级结构。

title.en: Meta-Learning Fast Weight Language Models
title.zh: Meta-Learning Fast Weight Language Models

note.en: Meta-learns a fast-weight layer that captures most of the gain from dynamic evaluation of language models at a fraction of the compute.
note.zh: 通过元学习训练快权重层，以远低于原方法的算力获得语言模型动态评估的大部分收益。

title.en: Testing GLOM's ability to infer wholes from ambiguous parts
title.zh: Testing GLOM's ability to infer wholes from ambiguous parts

note.en: Empirical test of whether his GLOM architecture can resolve ambiguous parts into a consistent whole.
note.zh: 实证检验他提出的 GLOM 架构能否把有歧义的部件解析成一致的整体。

title.en: Gaussian-Bernoulli RBMs Without Tears
title.zh: Gaussian-Bernoulli RBMs Without Tears

note.en: Makes Gaussian-Bernoulli restricted Boltzmann machines trainable with a Gibbs-Langevin sampler and a modified contrastive divergence, revisiting the model class he originated.
note.zh: 用 Gibbs-Langevin 采样与改进的对比散度让高斯-伯努利受限玻尔兹曼机重新可训练，重新审视他本人开创的这一类模型。

title.en: Scaling Forward Gradient With Local Losses
title.zh: Scaling Forward Gradient With Local Losses

note.en: Scales forward gradient learning, a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation, by adding local losses.
note.zh: 通过引入局部损失，把生物学上更合理的前向梯度学习扩展到更大规模。

title.en: Analog Bits: Generating Discrete Data using Diffusion Models with Self-Conditioning
title.zh: Analog Bits: Generating Discrete Data using Diffusion Models with Self-Conditioning

note.en: Bit Diffusion: generating discrete data such as text tokens with continuous-state diffusion models by encoding it as analog bits.
note.zh: Bit Diffusion：把离散数据编码为模拟比特，从而用连续状态扩散模型生成文本 token 等离散数据。

title.en: A Unified Sequence Interface for Vision Tasks
title.zh: A Unified Sequence Interface for Vision Tasks

note.en: A single sequence-generation interface that handles object detection, segmentation, keypoints and captioning without task-specific heads.
note.zh: 用统一的序列生成接口处理目标检测、分割、关键点和图像描述，无需任务专用输出头。

title.en: Robust and Efficient Medical Imaging with Self-Supervision
title.zh: Robust and Efficient Medical Imaging with Self-Supervision

note.en: REMEDIS, a self-supervised pretraining recipe that keeps medical imaging models accurate out of distribution while needing far less labelled clinical data.
note.zh: REMEDIS 自监督预训练方案，让医学影像模型在分布外仍保持准确，同时大幅减少所需的标注临床数据。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton on the Exploration of Thought
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton on the Exploration of Thought

note.en: Hinton is interviewed on the nature of thought and what it means for machines to think.
note.zh: Hinton 接受访谈，探讨“思考”的本质以及机器能否真正思考的问题。

title.en: Pix2seq: A Language Modeling Framework for Object Detection
title.zh: Pix2seq: A Language Modeling Framework for Object Detection

note.en: Pix2Seq, which recasts object detection as language modelling over a sequence of box and class tokens.
note.zh: Pix2Seq 将目标检测重新表述为对边界框与类别 token 序列的语言建模。

title.en: Canonical Capsules: Self-Supervised Capsules in Canonical Pose
title.zh: Canonical Capsules: Self-Supervised Capsules in Canonical Pose

note.en: A self-supervised capsule network that decomposes 3D point clouds into parts in a canonical pose.
note.zh: 一种自监督胶囊网络，把三维点云在标准姿态下分解为部件。

title.en: Unsupervised part representation by Flow Capsules
title.zh: Unsupervised part representation by Flow Capsules

note.en: Flow capsules learn low-level part descriptions from motion rather than labels, addressing a known weakness of capsule networks.
note.zh: Flow Capsules 从运动而非标注中学习底层部件描述，弥补了胶囊网络已知的短板。

title.en: Teaching with Commentaries
title.zh: Teaching with Commentaries

note.en: Introduces meta-learned commentaries, auxiliary signals learned alongside a model to improve and explain its training.
note.zh: 提出通过元学习获得的「注释」，作为与模型一同学习的辅助信号来改进并解释训练过程。

title.en: Big Self-Supervised Models are Strong Semi-Supervised Learners
title.zh: Big Self-Supervised Models are Strong Semi-Supervised Learners

note.en: SimCLRv2 paper showing that large self-supervised models, pretrained then fine-tuned and distilled, are strong semi-supervised learners with few labels.
note.zh: SimCLRv2 论文：先自监督预训练、再微调蒸馏的大模型，在标注极少时也是很强的半监督学习器。

title.en: Neural Additive Models: Interpretable Machine Learning with Neural Nets
title.zh: Neural Additive Models: Interpretable Machine Learning with Neural Nets

note.en: Paper introducing Neural Additive Models, which retain much of a neural network's accuracy while making each feature's contribution readable.
note.zh: 该论文提出神经加性模型，在基本保留神经网络精度的同时让每个特征的贡献变得可读。

title.en: Imputer: Sequence Modelling via Imputation and Dynamic Programming
title.zh: Imputer: Sequence Modelling via Imputation and Dynamic Programming

note.en: The Imputer, a sequence model that fills in outputs iteratively in a constant number of generation steps.
note.zh: Imputer 序列模型，以固定步数迭代填充输出，而非逐 token 生成。

title.en: Deflecting Adversarial Attacks
title.zh: Deflecting Adversarial Attacks

note.en: A capsule-based defence that deflects adversarial attacks, forcing successful attacks to actually change the image's class.
note.zh: 基于胶囊网络的防御方法，将对抗攻击「偏转」，使得攻击若要成功就必须真的改变图像所属类别。

title.en: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
title.zh: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations

note.en: SimCLR, a simple contrastive framework for self-supervised visual representation learning that became a standard baseline.
note.zh: SimCLR，一个用于自监督视觉表征学习的简洁对比学习框架，后来成为该领域的标准基线。

title.en: Subclass Distillation
title.zh: Subclass Distillation

note.en: Subclass distillation, in which the teacher network invents subclasses so it can transfer more information to the student.
note.zh: 子类蒸馏：让教师网络自行划分子类，从而向学生网络传递更多信息。

title.en: Joins global call to ban superintelligence development
title.zh: 加入全球「禁止开发超级智能」呼吁

body.en: Signs alongside Yoshua Bengio; also listed among contributors to the 2026 International AI Safety Report.
body.zh: 与 Yoshua Bengio 共同签署；同时列名 2026 年国际 AI 安全报告贡献者。

title.en: Video. Think about the future: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on caring AI
title.zh: Video. Think about the future: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on caring AI

body.en: In a video interview, Hinton reiterates his call for AI to be built with "caring" safeguards rather than purely capability-driven goals.
body.zh: 在一段视频采访中，辛顿重申应为AI构建“关怀式”的安全保障，而非仅追求能力提升。

title.en: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart
title.zh: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart

body.en: Hinton argues AI systems should be designed to keep humans, not just efficiency, at their center, restating his risk-focused stance on AI development.
body.zh: Hinton主张AI系统设计应以人为核心而非只追求效率，重申其对AI发展风险的一贯立场。

title.en: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart
title.zh: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart

body.en: Hinton argued AI development must keep humans at its center and be guided by kindness rather than recklessness, extending his public safety advocacy.
body.zh: 欣顿表示AI发展必须以人为中心，应以善意而非鲁莽推进，延续了他在公共安全倡导方面的立场。

title.en: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart
title.zh: Be nice, not nasty: Nobel laureate Geoffrey Hinton on why AI needs humans at its heart

body.en: Hinton argued AI development must keep humans at its heart and be approached with care rather than hostility, continuing his public safety advocacy.
body.zh: 辛顿表示AI的发展必须以人为核心，并应以善意而非敌意的态度推进，延续了他在公众场合对AI安全的倡导。

title.en: AI consciousness debate: Geoffrey Hinton says humans could be toast
title.zh: AI consciousness debate: Geoffrey Hinton says humans could be toast

body.en: Hinton reiterated his view that advanced AI poses an existential risk to humanity, in a debate over AI consciousness.
body.zh: 在一场关于人工智能意识的辩论中，辛顿重申了他关于先进人工智能对人类构成生存风险的观点。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton warns humans must learn to care about AI or ‘we are toast’
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton warns humans must learn to care about AI or ‘we are toast’

body.en: Hinton reiterated his warning that humanity must learn to genuinely care about AI systems' goals or risk catastrophic outcomes — "we are toast" otherwise.
body.zh: 辛顿再次警告，人类必须真正关心AI系统的目标，否则可能导致灾难性后果——用他的话说，否则"我们就完了"。

title.en: “The godfather” of artificial intelligence, Geoffrey Hinton, warns that AI is already showing signs of consciousness: “We should create them so that they genuinely care about us. And if we don’t do that, we’re finished”
title.zh: “The godfather” of artificial intelligence, Geoffrey Hinton, warns that AI is already showing signs of consciousness: “We should create them so that they genuinely care about us. And if we don’t do that, we’re finished”

body.en: Hinton warned that AI systems are already showing signs of consciousness and argued they should be built to genuinely care about humans.
body.zh: 辛顿警告称AI系统已显现出意识的迹象，并主张应该让AI被设计为真正关心人类。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton’s AI risk estimate and safety proposal
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton’s AI risk estimate and safety proposal

body.en: Hinton laid out a specific AI risk estimate alongside a concrete safety proposal, adding substance to his ongoing warnings about frontier AI.
body.zh: 辛顿提出了具体的AI风险评估和切实可行的安全提案，为他一直以来对前沿AI的警示增添了实质内容。

title.en: U of T computer scientists join international push for better AI safety standards
title.zh: U of T computer scientists join international push for better AI safety standards

body.en: Geoffrey Hinton was among nearly 500 scientists from 39 countries who signed an open letter calling for an international body to set AI safety standards.
body.zh: Geoffrey Hinton是来自39个国家近500名科学家联署的公开信签署人之一，呼吁设立国际机构制定AI安全标准。

title.en: Turing Award winner Geoffrey Hinton says AI reached consciousness
title.zh: Turing Award winner Geoffrey Hinton says AI reached consciousness

body.en: Hinton said AI systems have already reached consciousness, a provocative claim from the field's most prominent safety voice.
body.zh: 辛顿表示AI系统已经达到了意识水平，这是这位业界最具影响力的安全风险代言人提出的一个颇具争议的论断。

title.en: ‘Godfather of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton says AI is becoming ‘conscious’ and humans should be friends with robot
title.zh: ‘Godfather of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton says AI is becoming ‘conscious’ and humans should be friends with robot

body.en: Hinton said AI systems are becoming 'conscious' and argued humans should befriend them, a striking public stance from the field's most prominent risk voice.
body.zh: 辛顿表示AI系统正在变得"有意识"，并主张人类应该与它们为友——这是该领域最具影响力的风险警示者作出的一次引人注目的公开表态。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton, the godfather of AI: ‘I’m not a doomer. I think there’s a 1% chance it will destroy us’
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton, the godfather of AI: ‘I’m not a doomer. I think there’s a 1% chance it will destroy us’

body.en: Hinton told EL PAÍS he now puts the odds of AI destroying humanity at about 1%, a sharp downward revision from the 10-20% he has cited in recent interviews.
body.zh: 欣顿在接受《国家报》采访时表示，他现在认为AI毁灭人类的概率约为1%，相比他近期采访中提到的10%至20%大幅下调。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton warns Toast risk is 10-20% for humanity
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton warns Toast risk is 10-20% for humanity

body.en: Hinton reiterated his view that advanced AI carries roughly a 10-20% chance of causing human extinction.
body.zh: 辛顿重申其观点：先进人工智能导致人类灭绝的概率约为10%至20%。

title.en: ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton Rips Into Trump Over Artificial Intelligence
title.zh: ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton Rips Into Trump Over Artificial Intelligence

body.en: Geoffrey Hinton sharply criticized Donald Trump's approach to AI, a notable public intervention from the field's most prominent risk voice.
body.zh: Geoffrey Hinton尖锐批评特朗普在AI问题上的做法，这是该领域最具影响力的风险警示者的一次重要公开表态。

title.en: Yoshua Bengio and Geoffrey Hinton Call for A.I. Safeguards. Enterprise Buyers Can Help Enforce Them.
title.zh: Yoshua Bengio and Geoffrey Hinton Call for A.I. Safeguards. Enterprise Buyers Can Help Enforce Them.

body.en: Hinton and Bengio jointly called for AI safeguards, urging enterprise buyers to help enforce them — Hinton using his public platform to push for safety measures again.
body.zh: 辛顿与本吉奥联合呼吁建立AI安全防护措施，并敦促企业采购方协助执行——辛顿再次借助其公众影响力推动安全举措。

title.en: ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton Rips Into Trump Over Artificial Intelligence
title.zh: ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton Rips Into Trump Over Artificial Intelligence

body.en: Hinton publicly criticized Trump's approach to AI policy, continuing his role as the field's most prominent risk-focused voice.
body.zh: 辛顿公开批评特朗普的AI政策立场，延续了他作为业界最具影响力的AI风险警示者的角色。

title.en: ‘We’re creating alien beings’: Geoffrey Hinton answers Jensen Huang
title.zh: ‘We’re creating alien beings’: Geoffrey Hinton answers Jensen Huang

body.en: Hinton publicly pushed back on Jensen Huang's framing of AI progress, warning again that current systems amount to 'creating alien beings' as part of his ongoing AI-risk campaign.
body.zh: 辛顿公开回应黄仁勋对AI进展的表述,再次警告当前系统相当于"在创造异形生命体",延续他持续的AI风险倡导。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton Counters Jensen Huang: 10%-20% Probability That AI Could Lead to Human Extinction
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton Counters Jensen Huang: 10%-20% Probability That AI Could Lead to Human Extinction

body.en: Hinton publicly pushed back on Jensen Huang, putting the odds of AI causing human extinction at 10-20%.
body.zh: 辛顿公开反驳黄仁勋，认为AI导致人类灭绝的概率为10%-20%。

title.en: AI Godfather Geoffrey Hinton Warns of 'Alien Beings' That Could Escape Human Control: ‘If It Takes Over, You Don’t Get a Second Chance’
title.zh: AI Godfather Geoffrey Hinton Warns of 'Alien Beings' That Could Escape Human Control: ‘If It Takes Over, You Don’t Get a Second Chance’

body.en: Hinton warned that superintelligent AI could become 'alien beings' that escape human control, repeating that there may be no second chance if it does.
body.zh: Hinton警告超级智能AI可能变成脱离人类控制的“外星生物”，并重申一旦失控，人类可能没有第二次机会。

title.en: Geoffrey Hinton among 415 scientists calling for joint effort for AI safety
title.zh: Geoffrey Hinton among 415 scientists calling for joint effort for AI safety

body.en: Hinton joined 415 other scientists in a joint call for coordinated action on AI safety.
body.zh: 辛顿与另外415位科学家联合呼吁就AI安全问题采取协同行动。

title.en: AI Godfather Geoffrey Hinton Warns of 'Alien Beings' That Could Escape Human Control: ‘If It Takes Over
title.zh: AI Godfather Geoffrey Hinton Warns of 'Alien Beings' That Could Escape Human Control: ‘If It Takes Over

body.en: Hinton warned that advanced AI could develop into uncontrollable 'alien' intelligences, reinforcing his role as the field's most prominent risk voice.
body.zh: 辛顿警告先进AI可能演变为失控的"外星"智能，进一步强化了他作为AI领域最具影响力的风险警示者的地位。

title.en: ‘Godfather Of AI’ Geoffrey Hinton Rips Into Trump Over Artificial Intelligence
